name: live-mood
blurb: “Wistful, late night”: minor at 100% confidence, 72 bpm, an all-minor i–iv–v, two long notes a bar.

name: demo-playful-16
blurb: “Playful, skipping down the street on a spring afternoon”: major at 100% confidence, 120 bpm, a two-note skip in eighths that never sits down, and a second pair of phrases that lifts it a third.

name: demo-restless
blurb: “Restless, pacing the room at midnight, unable to sleep”: E minor at 100%, 140 bpm, and Jev opened on F#dim, the one tense chord in the key, which code had ranked last of seven.

name: demo-fanfare
blurb: “Triumphant, a fanfare”: D major at 100%, 140 bpm; each bar's chord was decided just before its notes, and the tune opens with the fanfare leap A–D–F#.

name: demo-pop-loop
blurb: The four-chord pop loop C G Am F at 120; Jev writes a chorus over it, one arpeggiated motif per chord.
